input.subject: Apologies for your cracked espresso machine tank
input.body:
Dear customer,

I am very sorry that the water tank on your espresso machine arrived cracked. We know how much you rely on your machine, and we apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

A replacement tank is on its way to you. Thank you for your patience, and please don't hesitate to reply to this email if you have any questions.

Warm regards,
The Coffee Shop Team
